findings.title: A .l4 folder outside openspec/changes is now scanned
findings.detail: Before this change, isHarnessPath skipped any path holding a /.l4/ segment. Now it skips one only under openspec/changes/. A tracked file such as docs/.l4/x.json or openspec/specs/foo/.l4/y.json is now scanned, and no scenario pins that down.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN a tracked file under a .l4 folder outside openspec/changes (for example docs/.l4/x.json) holds a secret-looking line THEN scanRepository reports one ARCH_SECRET for it.

findings.title: A .l4 folder at any depth under openspec/changes is skipped
findings.detail: The rule skips any path under openspec/changes/ that holds /.l4/ anywhere, for example openspec/changes/x/notes/.l4/y.txt, and not only the harness folder of a change or of an archived change. A person could reasonably expect such a deeper folder to be scanned.
findings.suggested_fix: WHEN a tracked file at openspec/changes/x/notes/.l4/y.txt holds a secret-looking line THEN scanRepository reports no ARCH_SECRET for it.
